t: You're looking at Venus, Cupid, Folly and Time, an allegorical painting from about 1545, now hanging in the National Gallery. It was made by Bronzino, the Florentine Mannerist painter. His nickname may refer to his dark skin or reddish hair. Scholars still don't know for certain what the picture is meant to depict, so take your time and decide for yourself what you think is going on between these figures.
